items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: He's kin to Arnold De Pears.

ctx.x: What does he look like? Which Rudolph is that? He's a heavy star bright fellow. That's the one who's alive now? Yeah.
Rudolph Bollier. Bollier, that's right. He's kin to Arnold De Pears.
I see. Did you play any other instruments besides trumpet and drums?
